source_behavior.behavior: NewPlan clears editing state, replaces the editor with NewForm defaults, clears entitlement editor values, and clears transient error/message state.
source_behavior.request_contract: The visible control is a local editor-state transition only. It performs no persistence; saving remains the separate canonical save operation.

laravel_adaptation.visible_binding: A localized type=button New plan control carries the exact canonical operation marker and targets the authoritative tenant-scoped subscription-plan create form.
laravel_adaptation.state_transition: Clicking New plan clears draft/edit values, restores source-equivalent defaults, hides stale validation/success/clone feedback, focuses plan code, and scrolls the create form into view.
laravel_adaptation.truthfulness: The handler performs no fetch/XHR/form submission and does not claim persistence.
laravel_adaptation.repeatability: Repeated clicks deterministically discard unsaved draft edits and restore the same clean creation state.

security_and_tenancy.route_context: The control is rendered only after auth + tenant.context and SubscriptionPlansAdminReadController verifies settings.manage and the resolved tenant slug.
security_and_tenancy.guest_semantics: Guest GET redirects to login before the control is rendered.
security_and_tenancy.tenant_isolation_proof: An authorized tenant manager receives 404 when requesting a foreign tenant route; no caller-controlled tenant field is used by the control.

acceptance_tests: reference NewPlan semantics and exact defaults are matched
authorized settings manager sees the exact marked production control
browser-level Vitest executes the real handler and proves reset/no-network/no-submit behavior
English/LTR and Arabic/RTL labels are rendered correctly
GET/control remains read-only until the separate save operation
guest, permission and foreign-tenant boundaries fail closed

provenance.exact_pushed_source: registered separately in operation-parity-evidence-sources.json after this rebased evidence-bearing commit is pushed
provenance.self_sha_rule: A Git commit cannot embed its own SHA; the manifest registration points to the exact pushed commit containing production marker, focused tests, and this evidence document.
